parsed_output.root_cause: The zero flag incorrectly checks only the lower 4 bits of the 8-bit result (alu_res[3:0]) instead of the full result width. This causes false zero flag assertion when only the upper 4 bits are non-zero, as observed in the failing subtraction test where alu_res = 8'b11111111 results in flag_zero=1 but should be 0.
